purpose: Prevent formula selection by post-hoc return, inconsistent criteria, or incomplete market data.
warning: These are conservative research gates, not a guarantee of future performance and not authorization for live trading.

evaluation_protocol.development: Use for weight and parameter decisions; no final promotion claim.
evaluation_protocol.oos: At least 24 non-overlapping monthly OOS observations across at least two sequential walk-forward folds before claiming historical robustness.
evaluation_protocol.final_holdout: Freeze formula, data snapshot, cost assumptions and thresholds before opening the final holdout. Never change weights after seeing it.
evaluation_protocol.prospective_paper: At least 12 consecutive calendar months in shadow/paper mode after the formula is frozen. Log every signal, excluded stock, selected holding, price, simulated execution, cost and missing-data event.
evaluation_protocol.posthoc_periods: Can be described as historical diagnostics only; cannot be used to select or validate a winner.

minimum_risk_adjusted_promotion_gates.bootstrap_method: Moving-block bootstrap on monthly net returns

decision_states.REJECTED: Fails data integrity, has incomplete outcomes, or fails pre-registered risk-adjusted gates.
decision_states.RESEARCH_CANDIDATE: Theory-driven, reproducible and not yet independently validated.
decision_states.PAPER_SHADOW_ONLY: Data lineage is verified and historical gates pass, but prospective paper validation is still ongoing.
decision_states.PAPER_VALIDATED: All historical gates and the frozen prospective 12-month paper test pass; this is still not live-trading approval.
decision_states.LIVE_TRADING_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Requires a separate authorization, execution-risk review, capital limits, operational monitoring and explicit user approval.
